name: luna-worktree-orchestrator
description: Low-token Codex orchestration: Sol / Medium delegates to Luna / Max and, when the host supports it, edits the current checkout directly as unstaged files without a worktree or Git writes.

interface.shortDescription: Let Luna edit the current checkout directly
interface.longDescription: Keeps the primary Codex session lightweight and creates one GPT-5.6 Luna / Max implementation task targeting the existing checkout when the host explicitly supports that mode. Leaves changes unstaged and creates no worktree, commit, push, merge, branch, PR, or extra reviewer.
defaultPrompt: Use Luna / Max to edit this current checkout directly.
Delegate this coding task without creating a worktree.
